raw_segments.text: It was the jackal Tabakwee, the dishlicker and the wolves of India despise Tabakwee because
he runs about making mischief, and telling tales, and eating rags and pieces of leather
But they are afraid of him too, because Tabakwee, more than anyone else in the jungle, is apt
to go mad, and then he forgets that he was ever afraid of anyone, and runs through the
forest biting everything in his way.
Even the tiger runs and hides when little Tabakwee goes mad, for madness is the most
disgraceful thing that can overtake a wild creature.
We call it hydrophobia, but they call it Dooney the madness and run.
